dxy.definition: ICE U.S. Dollar Index cash index, not a futures contract or trade-weighted proxy

verified_routes.delivery: Daily / End-of-day via ICE Data API or ICE Data Files

dxy.blocker: No licensed ICE or Barchart credentials/feed configured. Public website availability does not grant a redistribution license.
dxy.action: Obtain index history and public-display rights, then configure BARCHART_API_KEY or MARKET_DATA_DXY_URL. The adapter validates cash-index metadata and symbol.

futures.observed_response: 行情权限不足，请前往行情商城购买行情卡
futures.action: Obtain COMEX/NYMEX API entitlements; verify the same near-month rollover rule for every history point; supply authorized daily closes via MARKET_DATA_GOLD_URL / MARKET_DATA_WTI_URL / MARKET_DATA_COPPER_URL. A local OpenD needs a local scheduler/self-hosted runner or an authorized HTTPS export; GitHub-hosted runners cannot reach this machine's localhost.
futures.no_substitution: Twelve Data commodity spot prices are not the specified futures.

forex.action: Set TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY in GitHub Actions Secrets, run Update daily market snapshot, and verify that the account can retrieve 21 or more completed daily observations for both exact pairs. No USD/CNY fallback is permitted.
forex.limitations: Code membership is verified, but entitled time-series access cannot be verified without an account credential.
